mechanismClarification.section: Interactive Ropes System; Jaroslav Sinecky paragraphs after 2011/Uncharted4 introduction
mechanismClarification.confirmed: Slack particle constraints become costly and can clip collisions when moving fast. A second geometric taut path wraps/slides collision edges and serves as invisible fallback in Uncharted4.
mechanismClarification.notConfirmed: An 8-unit maximum length, endpoint clamp, or exact algorithm that snaps all particles onto the safe path is not disclosed.
mechanismClarification.demoRecommendation: Show separately maintained wrapped path and a labeled illustrative collision-failure recovery. Any particle reset is our simplified reconstruction, not asserted production code.
